preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have n elements in the multisets a and b, where n is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) and all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in multisets a and b must be integers between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(b_i * 2 == a_j or b_i // 2 == a_j for b_i in b for a_j in a)
postconditions.description: For each element in b, it must be possible to transform it into an element in a through doubling or halving.
